notes:
The ring's flight from the welcome to your dashboard is one smooth glide, drawn at your screen's own rate, and it keeps spinning the whole way, with no restart and no change of speed when it lands.
"Welcome to talk2me" stays until the ring is in its place, then fades out. Your dashboard fills in after that, its status card fading in gently.
Each step of the tour now sits right next to the part of the dashboard it explains, with a small pointer at it. That part glows softly and the rest is dimmed.
